calibration.note: Base year 2024 calibration from the paper (Section 3 / Table 1).

presets.label: Modest
presets.narrative: AI spreads like a useful but ordinary general-purpose technology. Adoption is uneven, gains per task stay flat, and half of AI-performed work is augmentation rather than automation. New labor tasks replace half of what is automated, so the labor market barely notices.

presets.label: Substantial
presets.narrative: Capabilities keep improving and businesses reorganize around them. Most AI-performed work is automation, reinstatement of new human tasks is slower, and growth roughly doubles its trend pace by 2030 while the labor share slips several points.

presets.label: Extreme
presets.narrative: AI can do most cognitive tasks and productivity per task climbs fast. Nearly all AI-performed work is automation with no reinstatement, capital floods in, growth runs in the double digits, and displaced cognitive workers take years to find new roles.
